headline: Apple announces September iPhone launch event
summary: Apple's next launch event is set for September 9th at 1PM ET. The event, tagged "Surprise and shine," will be held at the Steve Jobs Theater. A livestream will also be available on Apple's website.

headline: Volvo’s cars will warn one another about hazards in the road
summary: Volvo is adding new connected safety features to three EV models. Cars will share hazard alerts, warning of animals or vulnerable road users. This system differs from crowdsourced navigation apps like Waze.

headline: Xbox announces disc-to-digital feature that digitizes your physical games
summary: Xbox is launching a new disc-to-digital feature. This allows owners to digitize their physical game collections. It's part of Microsoft's game preservation efforts for future Xbox consoles.

headline: Microsoft’s 25th anniversary Xbox will cost $899
summary: Microsoft's 25th anniversary translucent green Xbox is priced at $899. Preorders begin August 27th, with early access for dedicated fans. The console launches November 13th, alongside a matching controller.

headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's Beta Will Be Playable on Switch 2 for Free This Weekend
summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta is available. Play it free on Nintendo Switch 2. Access the beta this weekend.

headline: 6 indie.io Games Coming to gamescom and PAX West That Have Free Demos on Steam
summary: Discover 6 indie.io games at gamescom and PAX West. Free demos are available now on Steam. Get a sneak peek before the events.

headline: I've Tried Star Wars Zero Company on Five Different PCs, and It's Been a Nightmare
summary: Star Wars Zero Company is a highly anticipated game. It's plagued by severe technical issues on PC. Unreal Engine 5 is cited as a primary cause of problems.

headline: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy Review
summary: "Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy" is a prequel spinoff. It introduces interesting new concepts. Not all of its ambitious chances succeed.

headline: Video shows scale of flash flood hitting Nepal-Tibet border
summary: A video reveals the devastating scale of a flash flood. The flood occurred on the Nepal-Tibet border. BBC edited the distressing footage with warning flashes.

headline: Rocky Horror star Tim Curry dies at 80
summary: Tim Curry, beloved actor, has passed away at 80. He was famous for playing Frank-N-Furter. Curry starred in the cult classic "The Rocky Horror Picture Show."

headline: Murder arrests after fire kills two including child
summary: Two people, including a child, died in a fire. Murder arrests have been made in connection to the blaze. Police are investigating potential links to organized crime.

headline: Prince Harry and Meghan land in UK days after announcing move
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan have arrived in the UK. Their visit follows recent announcements of their move. The family, including their two children, flew privately from California.
